Get-ChildItem -File | Where-Object {
  $_.Extension -in ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp" -and $_.BaseName -notlike "*_light"
} | ForEach-Object {
  magick $_.FullName `
    -auto-orient `
    -resize "600x" `
    -define png:compression-level=9 `
    "$($_.DirectoryName)\$($_.BaseName)_light.png"
}
